findings.claim: The builder's summary and REPORT_KO.md header state '76 cases x arms T, N, D, R x 3 runs = 760 processes'; 76 x 4 x 3 is 912 runs, not 760.
findings.evidence: RUNS_INDEX.jsonl has 760 rows: 608 deciding processes (per case and arm one --repeat 2 and one --repeat 1 process) plus 152 sanity processes (D and R from the T build); 1064 JSON lines = 912 deciding runs + 152 sanity runs.
findings.correction: Write: 912 deciding runs (76 cases x 4 arms x 3) in 608 processes, plus 152 sanity processes, 760 processes in all.

findings.claim: The callback unit cb = rhs + jvp + ft + Jacobian callbacks adds counters.ft_calls also where no time-derivative callback exists, so 'callbacks' counts finite-difference time-derivative computations twice on P_scalar_fd, kt_vanishing and P_mass.
findings.evidence: P_scalar_fd|A N: rhs_calls 145 = rhs entries 145 (FD time-derivative calls included), ft_calls 9, time-derivative entries 0; cost table shows 154 (T 80 vs 74, R 78 vs 72). Without ft: GM_cb 0.52614 instead of 0.52579, E1 maxima unchanged, no verdict changes.
findings.correction: State that cb is the sum of charged counters (ft_calls for FD problems are not callback entries), or drop ft_calls where the problem has no time-derivative callback; the decision does not change.

findings.claim: E5 PASS rests on erratum E5-i, a change of the builder's own computation rule after the deciding runs; the pre-run formula of PHASE2_NOTES section 6 gives FAIL on 5 N runs.
findings.evidence: Reviewer check: no entry count exceeds its charged counter in any run of any arm, so 'uncharged entries = 0' (the frozen text) holds; the only gaps are counters above entries via ft_calls, identical in N, T, R. Erratum committed 23:59:05 KST in 76b5db08, disclosed in RESULTS.json and REPORT_KO.md.
findings.correction: None beyond the existing disclosure; E5 does not affect the decision.

findings.claim: E10 ('on every run') cannot be evaluated as written for the 8 N runs that start RODAS5P by a declared fact: A_D = 0 makes 1 + floor(log2(A_D/b)) undefined. The builder applies reading R6 and reports PASS without naming this obstacle next to the verdict.

findings.correction: List the 8 A_D = 0 runs as not evaluable for the count bound next to the E10 verdict; the decision does not depend on E10.
